## CON-PENDING-rehearsal — v73.4 cut rehearsal: release-tooling and tracker defects D2-D5, D9, D10 (dry-run probes, pre-release plan line, DRAFT refusal, cut_date and refs-block template, one remote per repository, verification lines)

**Status:** Ready for testing
**Type:** Bug
**Severity:** Medium
**Created-By:** Claude Opus 5.5 (rehearsal fixer subagent)
**Assigned-To:** Claude Opus 5.5 (rehearsal fixer subagent)
**Reproduction:** reproduced-host-fixture — REPRODUCED — surface host-only — evidence `docs/qa/rehearsal_v73_4_fix/tar_red.log` — red-command `bash tests/release/test_tag_and_release.sh; bash tests/release/test_render_release_entry.sh (on the pre-fix scripts of main 09d3ad2f)` — green-command `bash tests/release/test_tag_and_release.sh; bash tests/release/test_render_release_entry.sh (on the fixed scripts)` — env `host, scratch clone of main 09d3ad2f` — signature `RESULT: pass=403 fail=37 (tag suite) and pass=46 fail=17 (render suite); evidence sha256 edd69c0f54297a637991d08621180e225743c8eec00d8fcba5fc9c042840a0e1 (tar_red.log); review r1 RED of the r2 fixes: docs/qa/rehearsal_v73_4_fix/r2/README.md` — updated 2026-11-16T13:16:50Z — by `Claude Opus 5.5 (CON-PENDING-rehearsal r2 fixer subagent)`
**Investigation:** root-cause-found-with-evidence — root-cause `the dry run returned before any platform read; plan lines omitted the pre-release field; the renderer had no DRAFT or cut_date check and the template had a literal dot; --remotes was never compared by push URL or name; no check read the verification lines; review r1 B1: the checker tested that each field was present, never its value (evidence sha256 edd69c0f54297a637991d08621180e225743c8eec00d8fcba5fc9c042840a0e1)` — evidence `docs/qa/rehearsal_v73_4_fix/tar_red.log` — updated 2026-11-16T13:16:50Z — by `Claude Opus 5.5 (CON-PENDING-rehearsal r2 fixer subagent)`

Source: the v73.4 PROVISIONAL cut rehearsal of 2026-11-16 (REHEARSAL_REPORT.md sha256 74ecd83f35174902d7732b966d0393dfad21c46beb72eabd486d1b54f4a0b3d5, scratch clone of main 09d3ad2f, nothing pushed). Defects of the release tooling and tracker data, fixed class-wide in one vehicle:
- D2 (section 11.4.290): CON-211, CON-235, CON-236 and CON-265 are Ready for testing with no **Verification:** provisional line, so the count line said 25 provisional while 29 items were Ready for testing; CON-190 and CON-191 have a line with no checks field. No check refused either shape.
- D3: tag_and_release.sh --dry-run returned before any platform check, so a would-be SKIPPED-NO-TOKEN, an inaccessible repository or a GitHub repository-id dedup appeared only in the real run, after the tags were pushed.
- D4: the dry-run plan lines of GitHub (and gitea) release legs did not say whether the pre-release flag is passed; only GitLab lines did.
- D5: render_release_entry.py refused TODO/TBD but accepted DRAFT, so an entry full of DRAFT values rendered with exit 0.
- D9: the template appended "." after the last ref of the unmerged-refs block, and the heading takes MANUAL:cut_date whole with no check that it is a bare date.
- D10: --remotes accepted two remotes that push to one repository (the live checkout's origin pushes to gitflic; the scratch clone's origin is the same GitHub repository as github), and a repeated remote name.
Acceptance (test-first, section 11.4.224): RED tests on the unfixed tools, then GREEN; paired mutants killed; a checker refuses every Ready-for-testing or In-testing item without a complete verification line, run on the real database; the six items carry complete lines written through the engine. Follow-ups of the same rehearsal: D1 (CON-379), D6 (CON-381, CON-382), D7 (CON-PENDING-duepast), D8 (CON-PENDING-mirrorrefs), D11 (CON-PENDING-m3wurl, an owner action), and the engine coupling found while writing D2 (CON-PENDING-bodymd).
Fixed in: 3b958793 (D3, D4, D5, D9, D10: scripts/release/tag_and_release.sh, scripts/release/render_release_entry.py, the v73.4 entry template, their tests, channels.tsv, netgate_pin.tsv, the mutation harness, docs/release/README.md) and ce615e62 (D2: scripts/validation/check_provisional_verification_lines.py, its test in the full-suite manifest, and complete verification lines on CON-190, CON-191, CON-211, CON-235, CON-236 and CON-265 written through the engine). Evidence and sha256s: docs/qa/rehearsal_v73_4_fix/README.md. Host results: tag suite 403/37 before, 440/0 after; render suite 46/17 before, 65/0 after; census 99/0; checker on the real database FAIL (6 items) before, PASS (29 of 29) after; 24 mutants each killed by its property, all 9 mutation controls pass. Side effect, recorded as CON-PENDING-bodymd: update --description writes the whole free text into the description of five of the six D2 items (CON-190, CON-191, CON-211, CON-235 and CON-236; CON-265's description already equalled its free text), so their Issues_Summary rows became longer.
Review r1 (NO-GO, REVIEW_CON-423.md sha256 fe550511c6a6eb86b262c9ebef3b372f1d8aea85bd3e61a3e768df20d4e9fb12, one blocking finding B1: the checker accepted placeholder values such as `due: .`) remediated by a fresh fixer in ed6a21e0: the checker now refuses placeholder, empty, punctuation-only and template values class-wide in all six fields, checks per-field shapes, requires a real calendar date in due, ignores fenced lines and accepts the colon-less form (B1, M1, M2, M7); repo_key strips .git in any case and folds doubled slashes for hosted URLs while a local path keeps its .git and case (M3); the DRAFT, TODO and TBD markers need a non-letter on both sides on NFKC-folded text (M4); the gitea token shape has one definition, rc_gitea_token_shape_ok in redact_cut.sh (M8). Because the due check now requires a date, 24 Ready-for-testing items whose line said "due: next full-suite run" (or "next tracker review") were changed through the engine to "due: 2026-11-23 (UNCONFIRMED: ...)"; for 22 of them the description column now holds the whole free text (the CON-PENDING-bodymd class). Evidence and sha256s: docs/qa/rehearsal_v73_4_fix/r2/README.md.
**Verification:** provisional (section 11.4.290) -- job: on main, run bash tests/release/test_tag_and_release.sh, bash tests/release/test_render_release_entry.sh, bash tests/release/test_provisional_verification_lines.sh, bash tests/release/test_channel_census.sh, bash tests/release/test_redact_cut.sh, bash tests/release/test_publish_gitea.sh, bash tests/release/test_release_tooling_mutations.sh, python3 -I scripts/validation/check_provisional_verification_lines.py --root . docs/workable_items.db, then a tag_and_release.sh --dry-run of the next real cut with the real remotes -- checks: every suite passes with 0 failed, every mutant is killed and no control fails, the checker says VERDICT: PASS, and the real dry run prints one PROBE line per release leg with no token text and exits 0, 1 or 5 as its probes say -- layer: host-only (tests) plus runtime on the host (the real dry run) -- target: host, repo checkout with the release remotes -- artifact: main containing 3b958793, ce615e62 and ed6a21e0 -- due: 2026-11-23

## CON-PENDING-duepast — 24 of 25 PROVISIONAL items carry a verification due date already past at the v73.4 cut rehearsal (2026-11-16); the re-run-first queue of section 11.4.290(3) is not drained

**Status:** Queued
**Type:** Task
**Severity:** Medium
**Created-By:** Claude Opus 5.5 (rehearsal fixer subagent)

Source: v73.4 PROVISIONAL cut rehearsal of 2026-11-16 (REHEARSAL_REPORT.md sha256 74ecd83f35174902d7732b966d0393dfad21c46beb72eabd486d1b54f4a0b3d5), finding D7, filed by the CON-PENDING-rehearsal fixer. derive_release_facts.sh counted 25 items with a verification due date; 24 of them were already past on 2026-11-16 (the one not past was CON-226, due 2026-11-18). Section 11.4.290(3): an overdue item stays PROVISIONAL-DONE labelled verification OVERDUE and is re-run first; nothing promotes or demotes it on time alone. Dedupe (section 11.4.214): no item title or body names overdue verification lines (search of 2026-11-16; control CON-226 found). Note: the six lines CON-PENDING-rehearsal added (CON-190, CON-191, CON-211, CON-235, CON-236, CON-265) carry the due date 2026-11-23 marked UNCONFIRMED, because no scheduler entry exists for them either.

Acceptance: every Ready-for-testing or In-testing item whose due date is past has either been re-run (its verification job run on the current main, result recorded, the item promoted or reopened under section 11.4.290(2)) or carries a new due date with the reason recorded; the release entry lists the remaining OVERDUE items by id; a re-run of derive_release_facts.sh on the cut base shows the overdue count that the entry states.

## CON-PENDING-mirrorrefs — Refs with commits not on main differ between mirrors at the v73.4 cut rehearsal: 23 on seven mirrors, 4 on m3w, one codeberg-only ref; FINAL precondition 4 needs them landed or retired

**Status:** Queued
**Type:** Task
**Severity:** Medium
**Created-By:** Claude Opus 5.5 (rehearsal fixer subagent)

Source: v73.4 PROVISIONAL cut rehearsal of 2026-11-16 (REHEARSAL_REPORT.md sha256 74ecd83f35174902d7732b966d0393dfad21c46beb72eabd486d1b54f4a0b3d5), finding D8, filed by the CON-PENDING-rehearsal fixer. After git fetch --prune of every remote, derive_release_facts.sh counted the refs with commits not on main per remote (section 11.4.288): origin, gitflic, github, github_vasic_digital, gitlab_helixdevelopment1, gitlab_vasic_digital and gitverse each hold the same 23 unmerged wip/review refs; m3w holds 4 of them; codeberg holds only gitenv-r4:15, which no other mirror has. The mirrors therefore disagree, and the codeberg-only ref exists nowhere else. Dedupe (section 11.4.214): no item names unmerged refs per mirror (search of 2026-11-16).

Acceptance: for every listed ref, either its commits are on main on every upstream and the ref is deleted on every mirror, or it is kept with a recorded reason (section 11.4.288(B)); the codeberg-only ref is inspected before anything is deleted (section 9.2, section 11.4.122: no ref with unique commits is deleted without a decision); a fresh fetch shows the same unmerged-ref list on every mirror; the FINAL precondition 4 of the release template is met or stated as open in the entry.

## CON-PENDING-m3wurl — Owner action: the gitea release spec for m3w (git.m3w.org) needs its HTTPS base URL, which is UNKNOWN; without it the real v73.4 run pushes to m3w but creates no release there

**Status:** Queued
**Type:** Task
**Severity:** Medium
**Created-By:** Claude Opus 5.5 (rehearsal fixer subagent)

Source: v73.4 PROVISIONAL cut rehearsal of 2026-11-16 (REHEARSAL_REPORT.md sha256 74ecd83f35174902d7732b966d0393dfad21c46beb72eabd486d1b54f4a0b3d5), finding D11, filed by the CON-PENDING-rehearsal fixer. The rehearsal had no gitea:m3w:BASE_URL:OWNER/REPO spec because the HTTPS base URL of the gitea instance is not known: m3w is reached over ssh on port 2222, and that does not tell which HTTPS host and port serve the gitea API. tag_and_release.sh pushes main and the tag to every listed remote, but a platform release is made only for a listed spec, so m3w would get the push and no release. UNKNOWN: the base URL, the owner/repository path on that instance, and whether the token held for it has release scope. Dedupe (section 11.4.214): CON-412 (multi-forge release tool, In progress) covers the tool for git.m3w.org but not this missing release spec; linked as related, not merged.

Acceptance: the owner records the HTTPS base URL and owner/repository of the m3w gitea instance; a dry run of tag_and_release.sh with that gitea spec prints its PROBE line (token shape only, never the value); the cut step 8 command in docs/release/README.md names the spec, or the entry states that m3w gets no release with the reason.

## CON-PENDING-bodymd — workable-items engine: update --description rebuilds body_md from the description, so a body line cannot be added without replacing a short one-line description with the whole free text

**Status:** Queued
**Type:** Bug
**Severity:** Low
**Created-By:** Claude Opus 5.5 (rehearsal fixer subagent)

Source: found by the CON-PENDING-rehearsal fixer on 2026-11-16 while adding section 11.4.290 verification lines. The engine renders body_md as the header lines followed by the description column. In 216 of 388 items the description equals the title (measured 2026-11-16), and in items such as CON-190 the long free text lives only in the body. To add a line to such a body through the engine, the whole free text has to be passed as the new description, so the description column (rendered by Issues_Summary.md as the item's one-line text) becomes the whole free text: measured for CON-190, CON-191, CON-211, CON-235 and CON-236 (each row stays correct, the summary table gets long rows). The other engine path, sync md-to-db, keeps the description but rewrote last_modified on all 388 items on a test copy, so it was not used. Dedupe (section 11.4.214): no item names this coupling (search of 2026-11-16). No hand edit of the database was made.

Acceptance: the engine gains a way to change the free text of a body without changing the description (for example a body-append or body-text field), with a RED test showing the coupling first and a test that the change touches only that item; or the owner decides that the description column is the free text by design and Issues_Summary.md renders the title instead; the five rows named above are then made consistent through the engine, together with the 22 rows changed the same way by the CON-PENDING-rehearsal review-r1 due migration (CON-015, CON-016, CON-023, CON-043, CON-144, CON-159 to CON-162, CON-183 to CON-186, CON-189, CON-216 to CON-220 and CON-222 to CON-224; see ed6a21e0) and this item's own row, changed the same way when this sentence was added.
